banner: PRODUCT MANAGER | AI PRODUCT STRATEGY & WORKFLOW AUTOMATION
summary: Product manager who turns user research, usage data and market signals into a product strategy, then tests the end-to-end workflows behind it until the gaps are obvious to everyone in the room. Ran side-by-side comparisons of a legacy platform and its replacement, wrote structured gap assessments that exposed missing functions and slow paths, and turned those gaps into a prioritized roadmap that moved 60 enterprise customers across with no operational downtime. Builds with AI tools rather than only reviewing them: started Example Labs, a small workflow automation product, and grounded an internal ticket summarizer in retrieval over about 1,500 of the team’s own past tickets so its output matched house conventions. Runs customer discovery directly, with three design partners met weekly on real usage, and works across engineering, QA, marketing and leadership to ship and monitor product performance. Works in TypeScript, Node.js, Python and Java across product strategy, platform integration and software delivery.

roles.lede: Defined product strategy and roadmap for a next-generation freight scheduling platform, tested end-to-end workflows against the legacy system to surface gaps, and worked across engineering, QA and go-to-market teams to ship and monitor delivery.
bullets: Owned the enterprise migration roadmap end to end, moved 60 customers from older scheduling tools onto the new platform, and supported 90% year-over-year ARR growth across two years.

Directed QA planning and the automated testing strategy that raised test coverage from 55% to 80%, weighing breadth of coverage against confidence in each result while keeping releases stable and regressions rare.

Owned the product side of a move from a legacy monolith to a domain-driven services architecture in Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript and Angular, adding reusable REST APIs, caching and lazy loading that cut data retrieval latency by 60% and ended enterprise timeouts.

Ran a feature parity program for the new platform by influence rather than authority over engineering, turning workflow gaps into prioritized requirements, acceptance criteria and migration order so 60 enterprise customers moved with no downtime.
Tested end-to-end platform use cases against legacy workflows to find feature gaps, then aligned engineering, QA and go-to-market teams on delivery priorities and release monitoring.

Removed a two-week onboarding bottleneck by automating the customer data import instead of asking for headcount, going from two weeks per customer to three customers a day and making the migration program possible.
Sped up engineering delivery by adding AI-assisted steps to the team workflow, which brought the billing module redesign forward by four months and reduced customer churn.

roles.lede: Supported the integration of two acquired scheduling products into the Northwind logistics suite after a mid-size acquisition.
bullets: Led company-wide adoption of a feature flag platform, modernized CI/CD pipelines, separated deployment from release, and raised feature release frequency by 300%.
Built a small internal web application on the flag platform’s API that centralized flag monitoring and release control, cut subscription costs, and reduced team OPEX by 5%.

roles.lede: Drove data-informed product improvements through steady enhancement cycles that tuned ERP workflows to the operational needs of energy distribution customers.
bullets: Replaced 20 separate weekly revenue emails to a top enterprise account with one dynamic Power BI digest covering cumulative revenue and per-site drill-down, checking every figure against the warehouse before it reached an executive.
Led integration work connecting three accounting platforms and two loyalty programs to the core product, widening the product ecosystem and opening new customer segments.
Supported ERP product operations alongside engineers, QA and stakeholders to improve reliability, scalability and user experience across customer deployments.

roles.lede: Supported business intelligence work by building interactive dashboards, modeling data and producing insights that informed product and business decisions.
bullets: Built six Tableau dashboards on warehouse data across three customer-facing applications to support product analytics, reveal usage patterns, and reduce customer attrition by 20%.

roles.lede: Leading development of a small workflow automation product for operations teams, where an agent reads incoming requests, drafts the routine steps, routes exceptions to a person, and records what it did. Built the end-to-end flow from intake through review so a team can see every automated step and undo any of them.
bullets: Ran a six-month roadmap, shipped the first version, and started a second with an audit log, a team admin console, a command line tool, and usage-based pricing.
Built the review flow that shows each automated step, its inputs and its result, so a person can approve or undo it before it reaches a customer.
Raised a small amount of early funding to support the first build, customer discovery and product validation.
Built Python classification models to screen about 200 early-stage startups, automating first-pass diligence and surfacing 6 promising seed investments for the in-house fund.
